about_the_game:
Breakout remake with a tempest 2000 and Geometry Wars like twist. No in-game purchase everything is included. The ultimate survival mode with Infinite looping levels, getting progressively harder on each loop. Submit you high scores and race to be the global leader.

--Demo Mode restrictions--

Only 10 playable levels in arcade mode
Infinite mode is limited to 2 minutes
Scores not saved to Steam or BE cloud
No achievement to unlock

--Features --

Supports Mouse or Controller*

No in-game purchases, you get the full game from the start.

Arcade Mode

Infinite Game Mode.

Level Select Game Mode.

Global high score board, stored remotely.

Steam Leaderboards for each mode

Due to UI elements its advised to remove you controller if you want to play with a mouse.
